verify.test: bash -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 1; FENCE=$(printf "\140\140\140"); BLOCK=$(awk -v fence="$FENCE" "/^## Verification/ { v = 1; next } v && !f && /^## / { exit } v && index(\$0, fence) == 1 { if (f) exit; f = 1; next } v && f" README.md 2>/dev/null); bad=$( { for f in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json docs/shared-lines-allowlist.txt skill/work-pr/SKILL.md skill/work-issue/SKILL.md skill/init/SKILL.md CLAUDE.md README.md; do [ -f "$f" ] || echo "MISSING INPUT $f"; done; if [ -n "$BLOCK" ]; then bash -c "$BLOCK" </dev/null; else echo "NO VERIFY BLOCK README.md has no fenced bash block under ## Verification"; fi; } 2>&1 ); [ -z "$bad" ] && echo "structural checks pass" || { echo "$bad"; exit 1; }'
